title: JobSpy runtime dependencies and actionable provider-payment failure recovery
steps: Inspect actual JobSpy traceback and sanitized provider configuration
Repair Docker/bootstrap dependency provisioning and add import preflight
Handle payment/access failures once per batch with correct score counts and fallback reporting
Run mocked regression/full verification and deploy without changing user provider choices
Explain remaining billing/key or UI-route action
constraints: No API keys or raw provider error bodies in diagnostics
No automatic billing changes or switching to a different paid provider
Preserve jobs, documents, profile and search preferences
